augmentation: Conjunctive and repair baselines include an explicit copied original real module as fallback (no fabricated function bodies). Report these as augmented mutation, not unmodified upstream or natural evidence. Rename/arity/module move baselines retain upstream Python bytes.
mode_labels: Pairwise unions attributable deltas from every clean pair; combined and plan use full native integration. Tips must have empty target-relative M3 deltas. Minimal attribution uses the same diagnostic in full and leave-one-out states. Unsupported, ambiguous, incomplete and environment failures unlabelled.
oracle: Pyright 1.1.407, S17 CONFIG/M3 identities unchanged; full production/test plus mutation scope; isolated pinned dependencies without installed selected-repository packages
publication: Mutation only; D-Ev1 private/local per-case evidence and sanitized external archive; compact selection/freeze/aggregate committed; no release gate.
repository_rule: First three: latest timestamp (SHA tie-break) S17 eligible recorded merge with native tree equal to recorded tree, from already accepted development evidence. Two additions: the fixed dependency-light certifi and trove-classifiers candidates inspected for stdlib-oriented production/test imports, pinned at existing public clone HEADs before any mutation build. No repository substitution after this policy. Candidate shortcodes was inspected but not selected; no builds or labels informed that choice.
site_rule: Public undecorated direct module-level synchronous functions without varargs/kwargs, public undecorated direct classes with a simple nonvariadic constructor or no explicit constructor, and production Python modules; exclude tests and ambiguous duplicate names. SHA256 UTF8 seed|URL|SHA|kind|path|name, no newline; ascending digest then path/name. First one per kind per repository. No oracle or detector outcomes enter selection; retain all failures without replacement.
